name: a-timer-emits-with-no-inbound-batch
note: Emission does not depend on delivery. The block arms a timer in start and emits when it fires, which is the shape a simulator has — and it is the working side of ABI §4.2's pairing rule, since this module imports eio:timer and exports eio_on_timer. The prop call is ABI §3's SIGNAL_NONE: there is no signal inside a timer callback, and a signal-dependent expression configured here would answer ERR_NO_SIGNAL_CONTEXT rather than a null.
